mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% consistently predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to reduced risk-free rates and increased equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in <= 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 3.0% consistently predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to central bank tightening and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: Negative 20-day returns occur in <= 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A real interest rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL yoy change) below 1.5% consistently predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to accommodative monetary policy and strong economic growth.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in <= 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL yoy change < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) consistently predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in <= 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units consistently predicts negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to weak economic activity and reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: Negative 5-day returns occur in <= 40% of instances when HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 1400 thousand units and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) is below 700,000 million dollars, negative 60-day S&P 500 returns are consistently predicted due to weak housing market and reduced economic growth.
failure_condition: Negative 60-day returns occur in <= 40% of instances when HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 700000.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production (INDPRO) index consistently predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to stronger economic activity and increased corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in <= 40% of instances when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: A Q4 2025 GDP growth rate above 2.0% consistently predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 returns due to sustained economic expansion and increased corporate investment.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns occur in <= 40% of instances when GDPC1 Q4 2025 growth > 2.0%.
